product.title: The Asset Everyone Wants
product.summary: Three rounds of trade decisions with a live front-office index. The only simulation the public lesson catalog links.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students make three GM trade decisions, each branching into consequence text covering what went right, what went wrong, how people reacted and what new problem appeared, while a four-part front-office index tracks win-now, future assets, cap flexibility and fan buzz. A strategic identity is computed from the pattern of their choices.

studentDataProfile.notes: Public and login-free; stateless in the browser.

governance.maturityBasis: Live, public and login-free — the most accessible simulation BOW has. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Three trade rounds with stat deltas shown before commitment; choosing win-now moved WIN-NOW 50 to 72 while FUTURE ASSETS fell 58 to 34. Deterministic, no randomness. Ends in a full report with an earned archetype.
knownBlockers: The ending archetype is too coarse to reflect the play: an all-aggressive run and an all-conservative run both returned "THE BALANCED BUILDER" with identical flavour text, and only a maximally extreme path produced a different label.

provenance.evidence: BOW-WEBSITE/lib/simulation.ts header: "Track 101 · M1 · L2 · 'Opportunity Cost, in Trades'". It is the only simulationUrl set on any of the 24 lessons in lib/lessons.ts.
